invariants.statement: No forward transition verified without evaluation of provenance, state, consequences, rules, SCAR, authority, risk/impact (when pipe exists).
UNKNOWN ≠ SAFE ≠ LEGAL ≠ ETHICAL ≠ AUTHORIZED ≠ APPROVED
Downstream consequence may reclassify earlier decision; history not erased.
Later decision must not erase original evidence or rewrite history.
Law, policy, ethics, common-sense, risk, SCAR, institutional authority remain separately identifiable.
Terminal state must be justified by evidence, control condition, and transition; label alone is not evidence.
No transition may skip a required formation path without an explicit, evidence-bound route rule.

non_claims: Control is not implemented as runtime.
Does not produce legal or ethical determinations.
